title: introduce-prefill-telemetry-synthesizer-and-quant-escort
author: Elena Morales
release_notes: Adds a telemetry-driven prefill synthesizer to generate tenant-specific warmup templates and a lightweight quantization escort that applies safe fallback rules. Improves cold-start cost by ~12% on benchmark suites. No breaking API changes.
commits: synthesizer: add core telemetry ingestion and transform pipeline
prefill: generate tenant warmup candidates from recent traces
quant: add escort policy and safety thresholds
telemetry: add unit-econ tags and feature extraction tests
docs: add usage notes and rollout guide
description:
Motivation: Cold-start and sparse-traffic tenants still account for a disproportionate share of per-token cost. Previous default prefill heuristics were static and required manual tuning per tenant. This PR implements a telemetry-driven "synthesizer" that ingests recent request traces, derives compact warmup templates, and surfaces tenant-specific prefill defaults to the autoscaler and runtime. It also introduces a small "quant escort" component: a rules layer that applies conservative quantization profiles with fallbacks when a risk signal is detected (loss spike, high perplexity, or regen rate).

What this changes: Adds a streaming telemetry transformer that computes per-tenant sample shapes, typical prompt prefixes, and cold-latency fingerprints. The synthesizer produces a prioritized list of warmup templates and target batch shapes that the runtime can use for speculative prefill or cache seeding. The quant escort registers safe quant profiles for each tenant and a graceful degradation path: if quality regressions are observed, requests route to the next-safe-variant and a rollback alert is raised.

Checklist: [x] telemetry ingestion pipeline and feature extractor implemented, [x] synthesizer scoring + prioritization, [x] runtime hooks to consume warmup templates (experimental opt-in), [x] quant escort policy and simple thresholds, [x] unit tests and end-to-end prefill integration test, [x] small docs and rollout guidance, [x] dashboard and alerting for regressions and cost delta.

Testing and results: Unit + integration test suite added. Local perf bench (small synthetic tenant mix) shows cold-start median latency improvement of 9–18% and a simulated unit-econ reduction ~12% across low-traffic tenants. Quant escort prevented three synthetic loss spikes during fault-injection runs by falling back to a higher-precision variant. CI runs passed except a transient flake in the telemetry ingestion test which was fixed in a follow-up commit.

Files touched summary: Key logic is in services/prefill/synthesizer.py (scoring, ranking, export API) and runtime/quant/escort.py (policy enforcement, fallback routing). Telemetry ingestion and extraction lives under telemetry/ingest with a small Go processor that emits tenant-level metrics. Observability changes include a Prefill Warmup dashboard and an alert (prefill.quant.regression) that triggers on repeated fallback events. Helm values include an opt-in flag for the synthesizer so we can canary on a subset of tenants.

Review notes and conversation: Reviewer Avery asked for clearer invariants around safety thresholds; added explicit circuit-breaker logic and integration tests demonstrating rollback within 5s. Samir requested an internal API for exporting synthesized templates to the Dedicated agent — added a compact JSON schema and versioning header. Laila signaled concern about telemetry cost; we added a lightweight sampling mode and a telemetry retention note in docs to mitigate. Approvals: Avery (approved), Samir (approved after changes), Laila (approved).

CI: All mandatory checks (unit, integration, lint, build) passed on final run. Perf benchmarks were run offline and recorded in the PR artifacts.

Rollout plan: Feature gated behind helm flag "prefill.telemetry.enabled". Suggested canary: enable on 3% of tenants for 48h, monitor prefill.cache.hitrate, cold-start p50/p95, and prefill.quant.regression alert. If regressions > 0.5% of requests, auto-disable and notify SRE.

Related work: builds on ENG-2041 (prefill API stabilization) and schema in ENG-2120 (quant profile format). Linear items linked above track follow-ups for wider tenant rollout and expanded quant heuristics.
files_changed_code_snippets: services/prefill/synthesizer.py: def score_candidate(template, shapes): ... # heuristic combining freq and latency
runtime/quant/escort.py: class EscortPolicy: def should_fallback(self, signal): return signal.loss_delta > self.loss_threshold
notes_for_maintainers: This is opt-in and safe by default. The synthesizer writes artifacts to S3 under tenant-prefill/ and emits a versioned schema. If you observe any unexpected memory pressure in the runtime, disable prefill.telemetry.enabled and alert infra. We recommend enabling the sampling mode first to limit telemetry ingestion costs.
